# Washington State Legislature Digital Resources

> > Official digital portal for Washington State legislative information, providing access to the Revised Code of Washington (RCW), Washington Administrative Code (WAC), bill tracking, committee schedules, and public testimony systems.

This platform is maintained by the Office of the Code Reviser and Statute Law Committee to provide comprehensive access to Washington State's legal framework, legislative processes, and public participation tools. Users can browse statutes, track bills, sign in for committee testimony, and access detailed legislative reports and calendars.

## Key Topics

- Revised Code of Washington (RCW)
- Washington Administrative Code (WAC)
- Bill tracking and legislative process
- Committee schedules and testimony
- Session Laws
- Statute Law Committee
- Office of the Code Reviser
- Public participation and sign-in (CSI)
- Legislative reports and statistics
- RCW dispositions and amendments
- Senate and House floor activity
- Administrative regulations
- Washington Criminal Code
- Legislative reference materials

## Legal Code and Statutes

- [Revised Code of Washington (RCW)](https://app.leg.wa.gov/rcw): Access Washington State statutes and legislative laws
- [Revised Code of Washington (RCW)](https://app.leg.wa.gov/RCW/default.aspx): Browse RCW statute compilation and session laws directory
- [Revised Code of Washington (RCW)](https://app.leg.wa.gov/rcw/default.aspx): Washington State legal code index and legislative reference
- [Washington Administrative Code (WAC)](https://app.leg.wa.gov/WAC/default.aspx): Browse Washington State administrative regulations by agency and title
- [Washington Administrative Code (WAC)](https://app.leg.wa.gov/wac/default.aspx): WAC regulatory archive and state agency administrative rules
- [RCW Dispositions](https://app.leg.wa.gov/RCW/dispo.aspx): Track repealed, recodified, and amended RCW sections

## Legislative Activity and Schedules

- [Senate Floor Activity - Regular Calendar](https://app.leg.wa.gov/far/Senate/Calendar): WA Senate floor proceedings, voting, and bill calendar
- [Committee Schedules, Agendas, and Documents](https://app.leg.wa.gov/committeeschedules): House, Senate, and joint committee calendars and documents
- [Bill Summaries Guide](https://app.leg.wa.gov/billsummary): Guide to bill summaries, types, and numbering in WA Legislature

## Public Participation and Testimony

- [Committee Sign-In System (CSI)](https://app.leg.wa.gov/csi): Committee sign-in system for public testimony and participation
- [House Committee Sign-In](https://app.leg.wa.gov/csi/House): House committee sign-in for remote and written testimony
- [Agency Committee Sign-In](https://app.leg.wa.gov/csi/Agency): Agency committee sign-in for testimony and public participation

## Legislative Reports and Data

- [Companion Bill Report](https://app.leg.wa.gov/bi/companionbillreport): Companion bill tracking and legislative database reports
- [Legislative Actions Report](https://app.leg.wa.gov/bi/legislativeactions): Daily bill actions and session legislative activity reports
- [Statistical Report](https://app.leg.wa.gov/bi/statisticalreport/report): Statistical reports on bill status and legislative process metrics

## Support and Help

- [Finding Member Roster Information](https://app.leg.wa.gov/Rosters): Help guide for finding legislator contact and roster information
